_readme: Corrections to buildings whose turf record geocoded to the wrong place, each triangulated three ways before it
was written: a rooftop geocode of the real address, the point dropped into the State of Michigan 2026 precinct
layer, and the precinct the crosswalk sheet itself names for that building. build/apply_fixes.py applies them
to data/dorms.json after build_data.py, and adds the two precincts the 149 did not carry (polygons from the
state layer, polling places from the VAN polling location table, which matches the crosswalk sheet's Election
Day column). Every fix here is also a defect in the Master Turf Tracker; fix it there and delete the entry.

fixes.why: the turf address has no city, and the geocoder chose E Grand River Ave in Williamston, 15 miles east; this is the student high rise across from campus
fixes.evidence: US Census geocoder point match; state 2026 precinct layer; crosswalk sheet EV tab names City of East Lansing, Precinct 6

fixes.why: the turf address has no city, and the geocoder chose Oakwood Road in Ortonville, 22 miles away (crosswalk flag on turf 04-1107); the complex is Great Oaks Apartments, 940 Oakwood Dr, Rochester
fixes.evidence: Esri and US Census rooftop match; state 2026 precinct layer; crosswalk sheet EV tab names City of Rochester, Precinct 1

fixes.why: the street was misspelled in the turf record, so the geocode fell 9 miles north in Grand Rapids Charter Township; the complex is in Cascade Charter Township
fixes.evidence: Esri rooftop match on the corrected spelling; state 2026 precinct layer puts it in Cascade Charter Township, Precinct 5 (the sheet's Cascade row says Precinct 4, 2.2 miles off; the layer wins)

fixes.why: no street address on the turf record, and the fallback pin landed a mile east of campus inside East Grand Rapids; pinned to the Aquinas College campus, 1700 Fulton St E
fixes.evidence: state 2026 precinct layer at the campus address; crosswalk sheet EV tab names City of Grand Rapids, Ward 2, Precinct 21; the four Aquinas halls with real addresses already sit in that precinct
